verdict.rationale: INPI's own pages say the Guichet unique is the single, fully dematerialized window for company formalities, including registration, modifications, cessations and annual accounts. They also document online filing of acts and supporting documents, card payment through a secure module, electronic signing via a qualified e-signature certificate or FranceConnect+, and online progress tracking. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that a filing can be completed end-to-end online (the probes only cover unrelated state hosts).
